# Data Source: catalyst_project

Read an existing Catalyst project by its ID. Requires the `ZOHOCATALYST.projects.Read` OAuth scope and access to the project. This data source does not create or modify projects.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_project" "example" {
  id = var.project_id

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = var.required_timezone == null || self.timezone == var.required_timezone
      error_message = "Set the required project timezone in Catalyst General Settings."
    }
  }
}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.catalyst_project.example.name
}

output "project_domain" {
  value = data.catalyst_project.example.domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string to preserve precision.

## Attribute Reference

- `domain` (String) Project domain URL; null if absent.
- `domain_name` (String) Project domain name; null if absent.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `project_type` (String) Project type reported by Catalyst; null if absent.
- `timezone` (String) Project timezone; null if absent.
